title: Delegation spawn silently drops a slash command's arguments when the command template has no $ARGUMENTS (e.g. /review-code), so reviewer instructions never arrive
outcome: termal_spawn_session never discards caller text without saying so. For a prompt-template command whose content has no $ARGUMENTS, non-empty arguments are either appended (like a note) or refused with an error that names the ` -- note` form. The stored delegation prompt is exactly what the child receives.
acceptance: Delegation spawn silently drops a slash command's arguments when the command template has no $ARGUMENTS (e.g. /review-code), so reviewer instructions never arrive is done
